messages:
ellie_sales: Quick heads-up — Aperture sent an RFI asking for EU-only POC, SOC2 Type II excerpt, demonstration of sustained 500 embeddings/sec, ops acceptance matrix, deletion certificate, and a short POC SOW. Also asked for a pilot reserved price that can convert to a 12-month commitment.

sam_se: Clarifying: 500 embeddings/sec aggregate or per endpoint? latency target?

ellie_sales: They want aggregate 500/s with p95 < 300ms during market window.

sam_se: Short answer: hosted EU control plane typically hits ~320-360/s p95~260ms on rwd-embed-v1. Dedicated (4xA100 equiv) can do 700+/s with 4-bit quant + KV reuse. Recommend Dedicated/Private for residency + deletion certs.

kevin_security: I'll prepare a redacted SOC2 bundle (NDA) and KMS wording. Hosted offers customer-managed keys in EU control plane (no HSM). Private supports BYOK/HSM. Deletion cert: for Dedicated/Private we can provide signed secure-wipe; for Hosted we can provide purge logs + audit trail.

arthur_sre: Proposed POC acceptance gates: 1) sustained 500 embeddings/sec for 30m 2) p95 <300ms 3) KV cache hit-rate >60% 4) cold-start recovery <60s 5) canary rollback to previous model (10%) proven 6) SIEM log forwarding. Add model pinning + rollback validation.

ellie_sales: Add 'signed deletion cert within 5 business days post-request' and 'conversion discount up to 20% on 12m reserved' to the doc.

sam_se: I'll draft a technical appendix + a tiny curl harness for them to reproduce. Snippet to paste in RFI:
```for i in $(seq 1 600); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-v1","input":"sample"}' & done; wait```

upload-bot: Uploaded 'capability_matrix_aperture_v1.csv' (20KB) to thread.

kevin_security: Legal: deletion cert requires tenant ID and signed request. I'll draft template and send redacted cert bundle under NDA.

arthur_sre: Provisional pricing for pilot (2 weeks): Hosted: $6k setup + metered overage. Dedicated 2-week reserved burst: $28k. Year-1 reserved pool: ~18% off depending on commit. Mark provisional pending final sizing.

ellie_sales: Great. Next: Sam — appendix + measured numbers EOD. Kevin — redacted SOC2 + deletion template EOD. Arthur — update CSV with POC gates and EU flag. I'll compile and send RFI reply tomorrow AM and pin thread. :eyes:

sam_se: On it.

kevin_security: On it.

arthur_sre: Done — CSV updated and attached.

upload-bot: Thread pinned in #sales by ellie_sales for 72h.
